detectedLanguage.description: Language of the complaint text, in English, e.g. English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil.

englishSummary.description: Faithful English summary of the complaint, max 25 words. Mention the problem and the place/landmark if given.

severityReason.description: One sentence, max 20 words, naming the specific factor that decided the severity.

photoObservation.description: One sentence on what the photo shows that is relevant to the complaint. Null if no photo was provided.

needsManualReview.description: True if the complaint is too vague, contradictory, or the text and photo disagree.
